interpretation_notes: K_hall_p13 replaces both label-position K vectors from the complete donor forward across every L2 receiver head.
L1_0_to_K_hall isolates L1 sender head 0; it is distinct from complete donor label-K replacement.
Head 0 is the largest single sender in the saved ICL comparisons at all three checkpoints; sender effects are not additive attribution shares.
Saved choice-rate CIs are absent; paired delta-accuracy CIs are not absolute-rate CIs.
